title: Stock Valuation AVCO/FIFO Deep
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

product_value_model.note: No quantity field. Value field stores global move value OR new standard price per unit. Created per-move for adjustments or per-product for price changes.

avco_formula.return_handling: _get_value_from_returns() uses origin_move.value * qty / origin_qty — no retroactive recomputation

fifo_stack.mechanism: Queries is_in moves ordered date desc, reverses to get oldest-first, stack size = qty_available
fifo_stack.negative_stock: If qty exhausted, shortfall valued at last_move.value / last_move.quantity (line 578)
fifo_stack.remaining_qty: Computed on stock.move (not product.value), dynamically derived

scrap_accounting.entry: DR scrap_location.valuation_account_id (expense) / CR product stock_valuation account
scrap_accounting.avco_scrap_price: Current standard price at validation time
scrap_accounting.fifo_scrap_price: Oldest available FIFO layer cost (same as regular delivery)

account_move_generation.conditions: is_storable AND is_valued AND valuation_account_id on location AND qty>0 AND valuation=='real_time'
account_move_generation.return_dr_cr: DR stock_valuation / CR source_location.valuation_account_id (reversal of delivery)
